summary: BEFORE full recompute of 300-node DAG: 0.04ms; AFTER dirty-propagation: 0.16ms (within noise). Followup with expensive nodes (1.2k-op compute): BEFORE 27.44ms, AFTER 82.5ms — SLOWER. Root cause: test graph is a chain (node i depends on i-1,i-2), so one leaf change dirties the entire cone; incremental degenerates to full recompute + bookkeeping. Precondition identified: incremental wins only when the changed node's dependent cone is a small fraction of the graph.
followup: Rerun with fan-out graph (leaf cone <10% of nodes) to exhibit the win; command sketch in followup.py b01_heavy with deps={i:[i//4]}.
